comment: Pass thresholds for the owner-regression live suite, written 2026-11-04 BEFORE the first run and not tuned after seeing results (lane REGR TASK.md item 2b). A scenario meets its target on a model when passes >= min_passes out of `runs` reps. The release gate (tools/release_gate/check_owner_regressions.py) requires every non-xfail scenario to meet its target on each gate model. xfail marks a row whose fix is still open or in flight in another lane (UPSERT, FSCAP, PROG) or still open on main (routine prompt adherence, unasked-topic guard, loop freshness, loop cancellation) - the same rows the deterministic suite marks EXPECTED-FAIL; the train flips them when the owning lane lands.

lc-routine-content.reason: OIR-01 routine prompt adherence still open on main

lc-unasked-topic.reason: OIR-06 guard on extra content still open on main

lc-stale-checkin.reason: OIR-28 connector freshness in loops still open on main

lc-never-ask.reason: OIR-39 loop cancellation after a refusal still open on main

lc-silent-replace.reason: OIR-19/OIR-42 keyed-write replace naming in flight (lane UPSERT)

lc-frozen-turn.reason: OIR-40 progress signal / queued ack in flight (lane PROG)

lc-store-full.reason: OIR-43 file-store count cap in flight (lane FSCAP)
